Housing Department report relative to removing the following units associated with the property at 1341 North Fries Avenue: 1341 North Fries Avenue, 1343 North Fries Avenue, and 1345 North Fries Avenue (Case No. 894798), Assessor I.D. No. 7420-005-012, from the Rent Escrow Account Program (REAP) with the property to remain in REAP.

outcome.text: Housing Committee action: Approved: Approved Housing Department report dated October 27, 2026 (Nov 5, 2026)

summary: Removal of three units at 1341, 1343 and 1345 North Fries Avenue from the Rent Escrow Account Program, with the rest of the property staying in the program. The Housing Committee approved it.
